summary: Verified invoice-print A4 portrait switch. Opened print popup (window.print stubbed) for 3 invoices: #3868 (17 items, no long names), #3892 (10 items, contains product name >40 chars), #3893 (7 items). Extracted popup HTML and asserted @page rule, pagination, header repetition, and totals/notes placement.
critical_code_review_comments: print.js:314-317 comment reads 'Always print A5 landscape' but code now passes orientation:'landscape' to renderInvoiceHtml which ignores that opts value; the stale comment is misleading and the unused orientation arg should be removed for clarity.
printInvoice still passes { orientation: 'landscape' } (dead argument since renderInvoiceHtml no longer varies @page on it) — safe but confusing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: A4 portrait switch fully verified. Print flow: click printer icon in row Actions -> shadcn preview modal opens -> click 'Print / Save PDF' button -> new window.open popup. Stub via context.add_init_script('window.print=function(){};') then capture popup with page.context.expect_page(). Use `button:has-text("Print / Save PDF")` (do NOT use get_by_text with exact=True — the button also contains an <svg> icon so the exact-text node doesn't match). Modal cannot be dismissed with Escape reliably; between iterations, page.goto('/invoices') to reset. Verified assertions for all 3 invoices: (1) @page string exactly '{ size: A4 portrait; margin: 12mm 0; }' — no A5, no 'landscape' keyword; (2) n .page sections == ceil(items/10); (3) each section has repeated header (Bill To, brand 'Commercial Trading', doc-type INVOICE, and thead cols Item/Qty/Unit Price/Amount); (4) 17-item invoice #3868 -> 2 pages with rows [10,7], first page has NO 'Total Due', last page has Total Due + Returns Policy + Credit Terms + 'Thank you for your business'; (5) 10-item long-name invoice #3892 -> 1 page with 10 rows and full totals/notes on that page; (6) 7-item invoice #3893 -> 1 page with 7 rows + totals/notes.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — bug already fixed by main agent in /app/frontend/src/lib/print.js (@page changed from 'A5 landscape' to 'A4 portrait; margin: 12mm 0'). All other pagination/header/totals invariants from iteration_10 remain intact.
